incoming.name: History of Burnside
incoming.excerpt: The village of Glen Osmond was closely associated with the discovery of silver and lead on the slopes of Mount Osmond by two Cornish immigrants.

outgoing.name: Religion
outgoing.excerpt: Also of note is the high occurrence of religious affiliation (73%) in Mount Osmond in comparison to the Adelaide (and national) average.
